description: Antigravity-inspired Distributed Coding — linear orchestration with parallel workers, explicit ownership, and independent verification gates. Observable architecture only; no proprietary prompts.

roles.name: Sentinel / Team Lead
responsibilities: receive final result and present to user
constraints: should not perform the main implementation itself
should not absorb all worker context unnecessarily
should maintain high-level project state only

roles.name: Project Orchestrator
responsibilities: decide which work can run in parallel
hand off/restart orchestrator state when context becomes too large
constraints: dispatch-only where possible; should NOT directly edit source code unless no practical alternative

roles.name: Worker
responsibilities: report exact changes, commands executed, failures and unresolved issues
constraints: non-overlapping ownership; if two tasks want same file, orchestrator must serialize

roles.name: Critic
responsibilities: inspect correctness, architecture, missing behavior, edge cases, interface contracts, regressions
constraints: must not automatically fix the work
should not merely trust worker reports

roles.name: Challenger
responsibilities: test resource/runtime concerns, malformed inputs, interactions between changed components
constraints: actively attempt to demonstrate solution is wrong

roles.name: Auditor
constraints: must not simply trust another agent's summary

roles.name: Success Auditor
responsibilities: validate final result against original request
confirm no unresolved critical findings remain
constraints: Sentinel must not declare success until this stage succeeds

gates.description: Every major milestone must have verification gate
gates.onFail: identify cause → create repair task → assign worker → re-run verification with fresh instances

gates.description: Project cannot be reported as complete unless Success Auditor passes
gates.onFail: back to Sentinel → Orchestrator replan (Ralph Loop / Result Rejected)

structure.request.md: Original user goal, constraints, acceptance criteria

ownership.model: explicit per-workstream file globs with owner
ownership.rule: Never allow Worker A and Worker B to edit same file simultaneously; serialize or split into dependency phases

contextManagement.principle: prevent context degradation; do not continually pass every worker conversation to next worker
contextManagement.mechanism: workers communicate through structured artifacts/summaries; orchestrator carries current goal, milestone, dependency state, summarized results, review findings, unresolved issues; fresh orchestrator session between major milestones restoring from artifacts

executionModel.workerCount: orchestrator decides from task complexity, independent components, dependency graph, affected files, verification requirements, expected context size; trivial tasks remain small, large refactors fan out
executionModel.not: prompt → model A/B/C → merge answers (generic swarm)

extensibility.note: This is distributed-coding only; other patterns (Long Proof, Self Verification, Document Review, Iterative Coding, auto-selection) will be added later as separate patterns under teamwork/patterns/
